proposal.reason: Main functional change is in P2P transport registration: it adds multi-segment IPC buffer export/import, segment-count-aware register/deregister flows, and range/offset handling for cached registrations (`src/transport/p2p.cc`, `src/include/p2p.h`, `src/include/transport.h`). `memory` is also required because allocation mapping/unmapping/free semantics were changed to support multi-segment physical ranges and segment-aware teardown (`src/include/alloc.h`). `network` is additionally needed because proxy/FD transfer lifecycle changed with batch FD queries, per-connection imported-handle tracking, and proxy cleanup integration (`src/proxy.cc`, `src/include/proxy.h`, `src/include/ipcsocket.h`, `src/misc/ipcsocket.cc`).
